Identity

A modern, fresh system built around a capsule mark, electric gradients, and friendly lowercase confidence. The drug-reference wink is intentionally abstracted into “awake energy,” not literal party imagery.

App icon concept

A glassy macOS-style tile with a tilted capsule, lowercase m, and a mint “awake spark.” It reads clearly at small Dock sizes while keeping the full-size mark expressive.

Typography

stay awake.

Use Apple system fonts in product UI. For marketing, use a heavy rounded display treatment with tight lowercase spacing. Molly should feel like a native Mac utility with a mischievous pulse.

Shape language

Rounded capsule, soft glass, tight menus, and one small spark. Avoid thin line work in the primary icon; use bolder shapes for downscaling.

Menu-bar icon

A monochrome template asset for macOS menu bar usage, designed to invert cleanly on light and dark system appearances.

Dark menu bar

Included menu assets

The icon is intentionally simple: a tilted capsule plus tiny awake bead. It stays legible at menu-bar size and avoids relying on color.

Voice

Energetic but calm. Molly can be cheeky in marketing, but product UI should be direct and safety-aware.

Primary taglineKeeps your Mac awake, even when the lid calls it a night.
Menu statusMolly is awake · Active until turned off
Safety microcopyClosed-lid sessions can generate heat. Use Molly on a ventilated surface.

Do

✓Use lowercase molly for the wordmark and product name.
✓Keep the menu-bar icon monochrome and template-friendly.
✓Use “awake,” “flow,” “session,” and “lid-close” language.

Don’t

×Don’t use literal drug, rave, or overdose imagery.
×Don’t over-neon the UI; save bright gradients for marketing and app icon.
×Don’t hide thermal caveats in setup flows.
